p: High Street North is East Ham's main shopping street, a long, bustling run of jewellers, sari shops, grocers and some of the best South Asian food in east London, so it's worth turning up hungry.

Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, strictly 18+, so it's not a family stop. If you want a breather, Central Park East Ham is a short walk south, and the grand old East Ham Town Hall at the bottom of the high street is a fine bit of Edwardian architecture. Green Street, with its famous Queens Market and run of clothes and food shops, is close by too. With the Tube right opposite, it's easy to get here from central London on the District and Hammersmith & City lines.
